name: The Surrealist Occult
why: A talk exploring artist Leonora Carrington's visionary art rooted in alchemy, mythology, Celtic folklore, and the occult, in conjunction with the gallery show 'Shape of Dreams.'

name: A World in Transition
why: A salon using the G7 summit as an entry point to explore a fragmented, technologically advanced, climate-stressed world, taking a macroscopic view of recent geopolitical shifts.

name: In Praise of Noise
why: An emergent lecture-performance by artist and critic Kameelah Janan Rasheed exploring the radical potential of noise and the turn toward error as method.

name: Law of the Land
why: Former Deputy Solicitor General Neal Katyal heads an expert panel reviewing a consequential Supreme Court year, covering rulings on tariffs, birthright citizenship, and voting rights.

name: Small (Off-Broadway)
why: Robert Montano's 100-minute solo monologue about growing up small and bullied on Long Island and becoming a jockey; running through July 25.

name: PrideFest Street Festival
venue: 4th Ave from Astor Pl to 14th St
why: NYC Pride's annual street festival running from Astor Place to 14th Street.

name: NYC Pride March
venue: 26th St + Fifth Ave to 15th St + Seventh Ave
why: The annual NYC Pride March, running from 26th St and Fifth Ave down to 15th St and Seventh Ave.

name: Eighth Annual Queer Liberation March
venue: Union Square West to Foley Square
why: A grassroots Pride march stepping off at Union Square West and marching to Foley Square.

name: Pride for the People: Post Parade Party
why: A post-parade party featuring Jasmine Goode, Zack Wickham, and Peppermint, running 3pm to midnight.

name: Third Annual Tonitas Fest
why: A community street/cultural festival running noon to 6pm in Williamsburg.

name: The Brooklyn Garlic Takedown
why: A cooking competition centered on garlic dishes at the Royal Palms Shuffleboard Club.

name: Movies at the Palace: Harriet
why: A screening of Harriet (2019) with a pre-show performance by Vy Higginsen's Sing Harlem Choir.

name: You Are Not Alone: An Uplifting Show About Depression
why: Improvisers create scenes inspired by personal experiences with depression and mental illness, showing how laughter can help.

name: New Tricks Storytelling Show
why: A storytelling show where all performers are over 40, hosted by Adrianne Frost; tonight's theme is 'Hot to Trot.'

name: Date My Friend: Queer Edition
why: A live matchmaking show where friends pitch their single friends in wedding-speech-style presentations, followed by a DJ set.

name: Yacht Rock Choir
why: An evening of soft rock, smooth soul, and sing-alongs with the Yacht Rock Choir at the Gowanus Dredgers Boathouse.

name: Book Rapport
why: A comedy show where comedians compete in bookish games to see who's the most well-read, with judging from host Ally Spier.

name: Rooftop Films: Jazz on a Summer's Day
why: A screening of Bert Stern's Jazz on a Summer's Day (1959) at the Louis Armstrong Museum as part of Rooftop Films' summer series.

name: Tarot! Renaissance Symbols, Modern Visions
why: An exhibition exploring tarot's journey from a 15th-century Italian card game to an artistic inspiration, with rare historic decks and modern artworks; on view through 10/4.

name: Doug Aitken: Lightscape
why: The Shed's Open Call series presents performance works by early-career artists dealing with climate change, migration, and collective responsibility; through 7/25.

name: Lincoln Center's Summer for the City
why: Lincoln Center's campus-wide arts festival with free and choose-what-you-pay concerts, dance parties, and screenings; Sunday includes Jason Marsalis and a Nightbirds/Labelle tribute.

name: Vercel Ship 26 NYC
why: Vercel's AI-native, agent-focused conference comes to NYC for one day of talks, demos, and conversations on how AI agents get built, deployed, and scaled in production.

name: Kitten Meet & Greet
why: A casual meet-and-greet session with kittens at the Brooklyn Brainery.

name: Watercolor Fundamentals: The Very Basics
why: A beginner workshop covering the very basics of watercolor painting.

name: Rose Needlepoint Coasters
why: A hands-on class making rose-patterned needlepoint coasters.

name: Charcoal Drawing: Anatomy
why: A charcoal drawing class focused on anatomy.

name: Historic House & Urban Farm Tour at Wyckoff House Museum
why: A guided tour of the historic Wyckoff House Museum and its urban farm.

name: The Taverns of New York: A Cocktail Themed Tour of Colonial Manhattan
why: A cocktail-themed walking tour of colonial Manhattan's historic taverns.

name: Fragrance Appreciation for Curious Beginners
why: An introductory class on appreciating fragrance for curious beginners.

name: Watercolor Food Illustration
why: A watercolor class focused on illustrating food.
